description: Public Rights of Way Bridges is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Devon County Council. The portal shows 2016-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
